'''Dahz Thulaka''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who started off as a promising doctor but became embroiled in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. He joined forces with [[Talandro Starlyte]] to kidnap and torture visitors to [[Starlyte Station]] around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Those that survived his dark experiments were sold into [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]].

==Biography==
Dahz Thulaka's early life was one of hardship as he was a scrawny child and was bullied harshly. When he grew up he enrolled at a renowned medical school when a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] fleeing from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] encountered him and recognized sensed Thulaka's [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]]. The Jedi began training Thulaka in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] and Thulaka learned what he could but the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] called to him, promising him power. Thulaka learned what he could from his master before betraying him to the Empire.

Thulaka traveled the galaxy hoping to instruct himself on the ways of the dark side and began performing dark experiments on innocent people. Sometime before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] he made his way to [[Starlyte Station]] and worked with [[Space station/Legends|space station]] owner [[Talandro Starlyte]] to kidnap visitors. Thulaka would perform dark and twisted experiments on the captives usually either killing them or turning them into genetic monsters. Talandro meanwhile would impound their ships and equipment for profit. Any who survived Thulaka's experiments were sold as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] to the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]].

Around [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] the private investigator [[Denell Kel'Vannon]] was hired to find someone who had become one of Thulaka's test subjects. Both Thulaka and Talandro tried their best to keep the dark secret of Starlyte Station from being revealed.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Personality and traits==
Evil and twisted, Thulaka became a growing stain on [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. He was not always evil but the promise of power was too alluring for a man who had been bullied heavily as a boy. Peace and patience did not come easily to him which also helped speed along his fall to the dark side. He was unhappy that his experiments ended in failure however he believed that with time he would eventually succeed and his experiments would unlock even more power from the dark side. He was a short, scrawny [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] with [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and dark gray mottled skin. His [[Lekku/Legends|lekku]] were long and thin.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Powers and abilities==
Despite being Force-sensitive Thulaka did not have command or mastery over even the most basic force powers. He was a solid combatant and was well trained with his lightsaber and [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]]. He was also skilled in medicine, especially on genetic manipulation.<ref name="WHSV" />

==Equipment==
Thulaka preferred to dress in dark colors and favored a black and indigo hooded cloak. He carried a indigo bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], a [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] [[DL-22 blaster pistol]] and a double-bladed [[Knife/Legends|T'kyja knife]].<ref name="WHSV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dahz Thulaka was designed by [[Paul Danner]] and [[Bill Smith]] for ''[[Wretched Hives of Scum & Villainy]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1997]]. He was illustrated by [[Joe Corroney]].
